title: Caraer app manifest (app.caraer.yaml)
description: Identity, auth, marketplace listing, installer settings, app bars, and external OAuth for a Caraer app. Functions, webhooks, schedules, inbound routes, and lifecycle hooks live in sibling folders and are not listed here. Public marketplace apps need brandmark plus details (category, brandColor, image). Private company apps may omit listing fields. Use ${ENV_VAR} for OAuth client secrets; the CLI expands them on push from the process environment or root .env.

details.title: Google Calendar Sync
details.description: Two-way sync between Google Calendar and Caraer.

settingsSchema.name: google_calendars
settingsSchema.label: Calendars to sync
settingsSchema.helpText: Connect Google first, then pick calendars for your account.

settingsSchema.name: attendee_object
settingsSchema.label: Attendee object
settingsSchema.helpText: Object where event attendees are stored (for example Contacts).

uuid.description: Remote app UUID. Leave unset on first push; the CLI writes it back after create.

name.description: Stable machine name (snake_case). Used in APIs and as the default folder name.

label.description: Human-readable display name shown in Caraer (for example Google Calendar Sync).

description.description: Short developer-facing summary. Marketplace copy belongs in details.description.

runtime.description: App-level runtime for platformVersion 2026.2. Every function in the app uses this runtime.

authMethod.description: How a company authenticates the install. OAUTH2 runs Caraer user consent (preferred; will be required for public apps). API_KEY is the legacy installer key. Both methods inject body.installationToken into webhooks so functions can call Caraer as Bearer.

hideApiKeyField.description: When true (scaffold default), hide the installation token in the Caraer UI. Functions still receive it on the webhook envelope.

oauthRedirectUris.description: Registered Caraer OAuth callback URLs. Required when authMethod is OAUTH2. HTTPS in production; http is allowed only for localhost.

installUrl.description: Optional external install link (for example a ChatGPT connector page). Not generated by Caraer.

brandmark.description: Square SVG URL used in compact app surfaces. Required for public marketplace apps; optional for private apps.

requiredScopes.description: Permissions requested at install. Use records.<setting_name>.all (and properties_all / relations_all) so the object is taken from a MAPPING or OBJECT_* setting instead of a hard-coded object name.

settingsSchema.description: Installer fields (admins configuring the app). Prefer SWITCH, OBJECT_SINGLE_SELECT, and SINGLE_SELECT over free text. Do not ask for caraerApiBase — the runtime injects it.

settingsSections.description: Optional cards that group settingsSchema fields. Values stay on the flat settingsSchema list. Caraer lays out at most three cards across.

appBars.description: Buttons on a record preview/overview (action + webhook) or iframe surfaces (detail / tool / trait bar).

externalOAuthProviders.description: Third-party OAuth (Google, etc.). Separate from authMethod. Tokens land in body.secrets / body.connections. Expand ${ENV_VAR} client fields from the environment on push.

webhookRateLimitPerMinute.description: Max platform webhook deliveries per installation per minute. Default 100.

jobRateLimitPerMinute.description: Max installation jobs per minute (inbound enqueue, POST .../installation/jobs, handler-enqueued work). Raise this for import bursts (Google Calendar uses 120).

details.description: Marketplace listing. Required for public apps.

title.description: Marketplace title. Defaults to label when omitted.

subcategories.description: Keys under the chosen category (for example agenda, automation under productivity).

image.description: Marketplace logo SVG URL. Required for public apps. Prefer a CORS-friendly host.

textColor.description: Text color on brandColor (hex), for example #FFFFFF.

subtitle.description: Optional card description under the title.

settings.description: Ordered settingsSchema field names shown on this card.

name.description: Stable field key. Referenced by settingsSections, visibleWhen, optionsSource.dependsOn, and records.<name>.* scopes.

type.description: SINGLE_SELECT / MULTI_SELECT may use static options or a SERVERLESS optionsSource (see google_calendars). OBJECT_* and PROPERTY_* pick from the company schema. MAPPING maps properties between objects.

defaultValue.description: Initial value before the installer saves.

options.description: Static choices for SINGLE_SELECT / MULTI_SELECT / RECORD_* when optionsSource is omitted.

hidden.description: Never show this field. The value is still stored (provisioned ids, workspace handles).

visibleWhen.description: Show and validate this field only while every condition holds.

valueScope.description: COMPANY (default) stores the value on the install. USER stores it per Caraer user (Google Calendar uses this for google_calendars).

field.description: Name of another field in the same settingsSchema.

value.description: Expected value; a list for IN / NOT_IN; omit for IS_SET / IS_NOT_SET.

type.description: Only SERVERLESS is supported. The named function returns option rows for the installer.

serverlessFunctionUuid.description: Remote function UUID. Optional when serverlessFunctionName is set; push fills it.

dependsOn.description: Sibling setting names. The installer clears this field and refetches options when any dependency changes.

location.description: RECORD_PREVIEW and RECORD_OVERVIEW are action dialogs (webhook + optional settingsSchema). RECORD_DETAIL, TOOL_BAR, and TRAIT_BAR are iframe surfaces (iframeUrl).

uuid.description: Stable AppBar node UUID. Optional when name is unique and already deployed.

name.description: Unique bar name. Used to reuse the existing AppBar node when uuid is omitted.

actionLabel.description: Primary button label in the action dialog.

tooltipLabel.description: Tooltip for buttons and sidebar entries.

description.description: Copy under the dialog title for action-based bars.

settingsSchema.description: Fields collected in the action dialog before the webhook runs.

name.description: Stable provider key (for example gmail). Used in /installation/oauth/{name}/start.

clientId.description: OAuth client id. May be ${GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID}; expanded on push.

clientSecret.description: Write-only. May be ${GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET}. Never committed as a raw secret.

connectionOwner.description: COMPANY (default): one shared connection per install. USER: one connection per Caraer user (Google Calendar).
